jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Division: GDC

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Engineering

Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and high‑availability cloud infrastructures on Microsoft Azure and Databricks.
Develop and document cloud architectural patterns, reference implementations, and best practices.
Lead technical design sessions with Cloud Teams and Architects.

Azure/Databricks AI & Data Services

Architect and implement solutions leveraging the Azure AI stack, including:
Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI
Azure Container services (Container Apps, AKS)
Azure AI Search, Azure Cosmos DB
Databricks Datalake

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Develop, maintain, and version infrastructure components using Terraform and associated modules.
Implement CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment using Azure DevOps yaml pipelines.
Enforce IaC best practices, modularization and automated testing.

Collaboration & Leadership

Work cross‑functionally with Architecture, CICD, Data, AI and application teams.
Provide technical guidance on Azure/Databricks and IaC practices.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on experience with Azure and/or Databricks cloud engineering or architecture.
Deep knowledge of:
Azure core services (Compute, Storage, Networking, IAM)
Azure AI services and MLOps solutions
Azure Databricks ecosystem (clusters, jobs, Delta Lake)

Strong Terraform expertise, including module development and multi‑environment deployments.
Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines : Azure DevOps
Solid understanding of cloud security, observability, and cost‑management practices.

Preferred Certifications

Azure Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer

HashiCorp Terraform Certifications

HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003 or later)
HashiCorp Terraform Engineer

Soft Skills

Strong communication and documentation skills.
Ability to simplify complex cloud concepts for diverse technical audiences.
Problem‑solving mindset with a focus on automation and continuous improvement.
Team‑oriented, proactive, and adaptable to evolving technologies.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner — Enterprise Observability Platform
jobs.description:
Job Location

WARSAW DOWNTOWN OFFICE

Job Description

Mission

Own the functional design and capability roadmap for an enterprise-scale observability platform
— the trusted signal foundation that enables AIOps across a large, complex technology estate. The platform creates the telemetry, health models, SLOs, dashboards, and detection signals required by event management, AI-guided diagnosis, and automated remediation, and sits at the start of the detect-to-correct value chain.

You will help advance a modern, vendor-agnostic, composable observability platform
built on open industry standards including OpenTelemetry and Prometheus
, competing with the best commercial tools in a rapidly evolving market. Working at the intersection of SRE, user experience, architecture, and engineering
, you will translate product strategy into coherent capabilities — trusted telemetry, real-time monitoring, dashboards, synthetic monitoring, RUM, alerting, and SLO management — that strengthen proactive detection, signal quality, and continuous reliability across highly complex, interdependent application and platform landscapes. This is a high-impact role for a technically strong product leader who wants to shape state-of-the-art observability at enterprise scale.

What You Will Enable

Earlier, more reliable detection — Give SRE and operations teams continuous visibility into application health, dependencies, and end-user experience, with measurable SLOs and detection signals that identify degradation before users report it.
A trusted signal foundation for AIOps — Deliver consistent, contextual, and governable telemetry that can be correlated, enriched, and acted on by event management, AI-guided diagnosis, automation, and future agentic capabilities.
Faster cross-domain diagnosis — Ensure telemetry carries the identifiers and context needed to map signals to separately managed topology and service models, while supporting topology discovery from telemetry such as distributed traces.
Coherent self-service observability — Provide clear integration patterns, reusable dashboards, monitoring experiences, alerting, synthetic monitoring, RUM, and SLO capabilities that teams can adopt consistently and at scale.
Continuous reliability improvement — Turn operational evidence into better health models, SLOs, monitoring, dashboards, and alerting so recurring weaknesses are identified and observability improves over time.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end functional design — Define how platform capabilities work individually and together across telemetry ingestion, real-time monitoring, dashboards, synthetic monitoring and RUM, alerting, and SLO management; eliminate functional gaps, duplication, and inconsistent experiences.
Own the capability roadmap — Translate product strategy, SRE needs, and the competitive observability landscape into a clear capability-level roadmap, defining what each capability must deliver to strengthen the detect-to-correct value chain and enable AIOps.
Lead deep technical discovery — Work directly with SREs, operations teams, platform engineers, application owners, and architects to understand operational pain points, current workflows, telemetry needs, failure modes, and the complex technical setups of observed applications and platforms.
Define rigorous product requirements — Turn discovery into functional specifications, user journeys, telemetry and integration requirements, non-functional expectations, user stories, and precise acceptance criteria that engineering teams can implement with confidence.
Guide engineering design — Partner closely with engineers and architects on APIs, telemetry models, integration patterns, configuration models, scalability, security, and extensibility; challenge design choices and make functional trade-offs grounded in technical reality.
Enable topology integration — Define how telemetry signals are consistently identifiable and mappable to topology and service context managed by the responsible platform, and how telemetry such as traces can support topology discovery and enrichment.
Create a coherent, state-of-the-art product experience — Ensure consistent concepts, workflows, defaults, and self-service patterns across capabilities and personas, benchmarked against leading observability platforms, OpenTelemetry evolution, SRE practices, and emerging AIOps patterns.
Assure functional quality and measurable value — Validate that delivered capabilities match design intent, work coherently end to end, and contribute to SLO coverage, system-detected incidents, MTTD, MTTR, automation readiness, adoption, and user satisfaction.

Required

Job Qualifications

Engineering or deeply technical product background strongly preferred — for example, prior experience as a Software Engineer, Platform Engineer, SRE, Observability Engineer, Solution Architect, Data Engineer, or Technical Product Owner working closely with complex platform engineering teams.
Experience shaping enterprise-grade, data-intensive, infrastructure, developer-platform, observability, or monitoring products, with evidence of taking ambiguous operational problems through discovery, functional design, roadmap ownership, and engineering delivery.
Strong technical depth across cloud and distributed systems, APIs, data models, telemetry pipelines, metrics, logs, traces, events, dashboards, alerting, and SLIs/SLOs; able to reason about architecture and implementation trade-offs without needing to be the primary coder.
Proven ability to define functional product architecture, detailed specifications, user journeys, non-functional expectations, and precise acceptance criteria for complex technical capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to guide engineers and architects, explain design decisions clearly, and connect technical choices to SRE, reliability, user, and business outcomes.

Strong plus

Hands-on or design-level experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, LogScale, Loki, Tempo, Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, New Relic, Azure Monitor, or Google Cloud Observability.
Deep familiarity with SRE practices and the operations value chain across observe and detect, correlate and triage, investigate and diagnose, resolve, and learn and prevent.
Experience designing telemetry schemas, correlation identifiers, topology-aware integrations, distributed tracing, onboarding patterns, API-driven platforms, multi-tenant systems, or reusable and configuration-driven product models.
Experience with product discovery, journey mapping, service design, usability testing, or self-service design for highly technical products.
Familiarity with ITIL 4 monitoring and event management, incident management, problem management, and the detect-to-correct value stream.
SAFe PO/PM, PSPO, SRE, cloud, OpenTelemetry, or relevant engineering certification.

We offer

P&G-sized projects and access to world leading IT partners and technologies from Day 1.
Wide range of self-development possibilities (training and certifications paths).
Competitive starting salary and benefits program (private health care, P&G stock, saving plans, sport cards).
Regular salary increases and possible promotions - in line with your results and performance.
Opportunity to change role every few years to be in the best place for you and best for P&G.

At Procter & Gamble we embrace a hybrid work model
that combines the flexibility of remote work with the collaborative benefits of in-office engagement. Employees can enjoy the option to work from home two days a week while also spending time in the office to foster teamwork and enhance communication.

Watch this video to learn more about our full recruiting process: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0bicvbpy0gI

Kindly be advised that at P&G, employment is exclusively extended on the basis of an "Umowa o Pracę" (Full-time Employment Contract). Apply only if you agree to these conditions.

About Us

We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders can lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.

Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.

We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.

jobs.title: .Net/C# developer to the Portfolio Solutions and Derivatives Clearing Tech team
jobs.description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?

About the role:

As a Solution Developer, you will be part of a team responsible for developing and maintaining modern business solutions supporting two product areas: Portfolio Solutions and Derivatives Clearing. The domain is evolving, and you will contribute to building systems that create tangible customer and business value.

You will join a team of nine ambitious and creative colleagues, working primarily with back‑end solutions while also contributing to our future client‑facing portal, Business Arena. The role also includes participation in the development of several new cloud‑native solutions, in close collaboration with quantitative analysts within Investor Services and CIB, as well as our Solution Architect.

In this role, you will:

Work closely with product management and product specialists to explore ideas, refine requirements, and deliver business value
Develop and maintain business systems and integration
Contribute to the evolution of our microservice‑based architecture
Design and deliver innovative technical solutions across our product areas

To thrive in this role, we believe:

You are a solution‑oriented developer with a few years of experience in modern software development and a strong drive to deliver.
You enjoy working close to product management and business, turning ideas into solutions that create real value. You communicate well, thrive in collaborative teams, and are curious about financial markets.
You bring solid skills in C# and .NET / .NET Core, with hands‑on experience in Python, GCP, SQL Server, and REST APIs.
Experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, observability, or Angular is a plus. A positive mindset and eagerness to learn are essential.
Experience or interest in applying AI tools (e.g. generative AI, Copilot, or automation solutions) in software development.
Experience using LLMs as part of your development workflow, either professionally or through personal projects.

What we offer:

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual’s career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

Great opportunities for professional development and insight into Investor Services Institutions product landscape
A dynamic, professional, and multicultural environment
An empowering and inclusive workplace culture
Hybrid Workplace setup

Ready to take the next step on your career journey?

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today, but no later than 31st of August
. If you have questions about the position please contact Johan Schalling, Team manager by mail Johan.schalling@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks. SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Delivery
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to combine hands-on software engineering with end-to-end ownership to build APIs and integrations that support business-critical operations while contributing to a reusable integration platform. Welcome to Sandvik Group IT!

Some of the things you'll do here:

Build and own integrations from initial design through deployment and production support.
Work with modern engineering practices covering APIs, automation, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Turn delivery experience into reusable components, templates and technical improvements.

Your mission

In this role, you design, develop and maintain custom integrations and APIs for business areas and projects built natively on Azure Integration Services. Your work combines hands-on engineering with production responsibility, and you ensure that each delivery follows standardized patterns for security, logging, monitoring, resilience and error handling. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

Design and develop production-ready APIs and integrations using synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven patterns with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management.
Build integration logic, APIs and automation components in C# or Python, supported by Bash or PowerShell scripting.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for repeatable, automated deployments.
Implement technical guardrails for authentication, authorization, secrets, certificates, networking, logging, monitoring and policy validation.
Own live integrations in production, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident resolution and performance improvements.
Convert delivery learnings into reusable templates, platform components, runbooks, post-mortems and clear technical documentation.

Location

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

Your profile

You’re an experienced integration engineer with a strong background in building and operating enterprise integrations. Combining software engineering with integration expertise, you understand how APIs, cloud services, automation and operations come together to create secure, reliable and maintainable solutions.

Your background also includes:

Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management. You’ve designed resilient integrations with effective retry, error-handling and monitoring approaches and understand the engineering practices required to operate integrations in production.
Strong programming skills in C# or Python, alongside experience using Bash or PowerShell for deployment and operational automation.
Practical knowledge of REST APIs, messaging, asynchronous communication, and event-driven integration patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, automated deployments and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep or similar technologies.
Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, observability, resilience, security controls, and production support.

Methodical and pragmatic in your approach, you stay composed when solving incidents and complex technical challenges. You take ownership, listen closely to business needs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability. Collaboration comes naturally, and you enjoy sharing knowledge with architects, platform engineers, product stakeholders, and other delivery teams.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative, and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort, so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together, and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Mikael Berglund, hiring manager, mikael.b.berglund@sandvik.com
